description: Check an outgoing payment batch for likely duplicate payments before it is released. Send the payments (payee code, amount, optional invoice or remittance reference) and, if you have them, the payments already released recently with their dates. Get back every payment that looks like a repeat and why: the same payee, amount and reference; the same payee and reference with another amount; the same payee and amount with another or no reference; or the same reference and amount under another payee code (often a payee set up twice). Also the amount at risk, the batch total and the amount that is clear to release. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/payment-batch-dedupe). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

batch_date.description: Release date of this batch, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed when you send paid (the window counts days back from it).

days_window.description: Same payee and same amount with a different or missing reference count against an already-released payment only when it was released at most this many days before batch_date (default 30).

paid.description: Optional: payments already released (up to 200), each with payee, amount, reference and paid_on, to catch a repeat of a payment already made.

amount.description: Payment amount (above 0, in the batch's currency).

paid_on.description: Date the earlier payment was released, YYYY-MM-DD.

payee.description: Your payee (vendor) code, the same code your system uses for one payee. Not a name, tax ID or bank account.

reference.description: Optional: the invoice number or remittance reference the payment settles (up to 12 digits in a row, not counting leading zeros).

payments.description: The outgoing batch (up to 200 payments), in the order you would release them.

amount.description: Payment amount (above 0, in the batch's currency).

payee.description: Your payee (vendor) code, the same code your system uses for one payee. Not a name, tax ID or bank account.

reference.description: Optional: the invoice number or remittance reference the payment settles (up to 12 digits in a row, not counting leading zeros).
